summary: Phase S3 passes the remediated API and developer-experience review. The public surface now has one schema/type/service/port, both adapters compose through that port, approved non-legacy entrypoints cold-import without database initialization, operational failures use provider-neutral retry semantics, frozen uniqueness and snapshot contracts are restored, all new mastery files are represented in the code graph, and focused public, canonical, Drizzle, type, build, and lint gates are green. No Critical or High API/DX finding remains.
nonblocking_findings: S3-API-010 [Medium] packages/domain/src/mastery/drizzle-mastery-persistence.ts:48-55 — DrizzleMasteryPersistenceOptions documents db as a schema-aware Drizzle database but exposes it as unknown, so a consumer compile probe can pass db: {} and only fail at runtime. This preserves PGlite/postgres-js flexibility but weakens construction-time guidance. Follow up with a minimal structural Drizzle capability interface or supported adapter overloads when the package API is versioned; this does not block Phase S3 because the factory is authority-bound and the real PGlite path is covered.

S3-API-011 [Low] packages/domain/src/mastery/README.md:1-24 — the new boundary and error documentation is accurate, but it remains reference-oriented rather than copy-paste-oriented: it has no complete service-plus-adapter example or migration prerequisite example. Add one concise server composition example during S4 consumer-governance documentation.

S3-API-012 [Low] packages/domain/src/mastery/legacy.ts:56-59 — the exported resetRateLimitStore compatibility wrapper has a descriptive JSDoc comment but omits an explicit @returns tag, and its asynchronous lazy reset cannot provide the old synchronous test-helper timing guarantee. No production caller was found; document it as best-effort or expose an awaited test helper if a consumer needs deterministic reset semantics.
evidence: The public package now exposes explicit mastery facade, contracts, service, memory-adapter, Drizzle-adapter, and legacy subpaths; the facade no longer eagerly exports the DB-bound record-run implementation.

The public API suite passes 9/9, including DB-variable-free cold imports of the facade and every approved pure/injected subpath, package export checks, exact schema/type inference, legacy-name compatibility, and direct Drizzle-adapter-to-service compile composition.

The canonical schema, in-memory adapter, and transport-independent service selection passes 27/27 focused assertions; the Drizzle shared and adversarial selection passes 30/30 against real PGlite behavior.

commitMasteryEvidenceInputSchema is a single strict schema, CommitMasteryEvidenceInput is inferred directly from it, commitMasteryEvidence parses that schema, and MasteryPersistencePort is the sole injected service boundary including calibration approval.

Both createInMemoryMasteryPersistence and the lazy createDrizzleMasteryPersistence return MasteryPersistencePort with readSnapshot, commitMasteryEvidence, and approveMasteryCalibration, closing the former transaction-port composition mismatch.

MasteryPersistenceError now distinguishes validation, tenant, idempotency, append-only, revision, unavailable, timeout, missing-migration, and internal errors with stable retryability; focused Drizzle adversarial tests cover connectivity, timeout, missing-table, serialization, and unexpected-driver mappings.
Domain check-types and build pass. Focused mastery lint exits zero with one inherited warning in legacy record-run.ts and no error in the remediated API files.

All exported schemas, inferred types, interfaces, error classes, and adapter/service factory functions added or changed by remediation have descriptive JSDoc; service and factory functions document parameters and returns.

The 0026, 0027, and 0028 snapshots exist with a continuous prevId chain matching the final journal entries. The restored placement and calibration unique names appear in schema, 0028 SQL, snapshot, and migration-repro tests.

The fresh graph contains every file under packages/domain/src/mastery plus packages/db/src/schema/mastery.ts; additive public service, port, memory, and Drizzle symbols are indexed and no pre-existing breaking caller was found.
No frontend route, component, style, or browser-executed API is part of Phase S3, so browser, route-parity, accessibility, and visual verification are not applicable.
